title: Jarvus

our_entries.enemy_kind: Red's missing apprentice, who turns to the Skullz and the robgoblins and has been conning every Sunstone race out of supplies with unfair trades (3466071037). Final boss of the Blacksmith line.
location_evidence: Skullz territory; Red sends the player to the Drake Boneyard and Feathered Graveyard to search (2234252732, 3927349836) and "He was over near the Feathered Drakes last I heard" (3466071037). The wiki lists "Jarvus" in the Sunstone Valley NPC list and as TCG card 5R20 (Rare).
